issue_request: FHIR-44498 was an Applied FHIR-core ExampleScenario change request resolved as Persuasive with Modification. It asked whether ExampleScenario step number values should include trailing punctuation; the approved resolution changed the valid example from "2c)" to "2c" and added guidance that the value contains only the textual step identifier, not separating punctuation.
initial_application: The Jira comment records application on git master as 876acc3a21. That Jira-tagged commit changed source/examplescenario/structuredefinition-ExampleScenario.xml so ExampleScenario.process.step.number uses "2c" as the valid example and explicitly excludes separator punctuation such as "2c.", "2c)", and "2c - ". Git blame confirms the current relevant line comes from that commit, and the commit is an ancestor of the worker branch.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists examplescenario as an active resource and ExampleScenario as normative, so the inspected StructureDefinition XML is in current build scope. FHIR Workflow minutes from 2024-03-11 list FHIR-44498 as Persuasive w/ mod, matching the Jira disposition. Targeted Zulip and Confluence full-text searches found no conflicting discussion or broader punctuation decision.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. The current ExampleScenario StructureDefinition already contains the approved punctuation guidance, and targeted source search found no remaining old wording that presents "2c)" as a valid step number example.
